reference_note: Published NVFP4 checkpoint in ComfyUI format. Used for schema comparison only; it does not load into TRT-LLM VisualGen, which reads Diffusers format.

generation.seeds_note: Three seeds per prompt. The counts above are deliberately small for a first run: 8 dynamic prompts gives 24 pairs, 4 verify prompts gives 12. Published figures used --prompts 16, which is 48 matched pairs. Do not read a control at 8 pairs as meaningful -- at that size the same-precision control scored worse than the measurement, meaning CMMD was reading seed variation rather than quantization.
generation.steps_note: 50 steps is a common production setting for FLUX.1-dev. Step count dominates latency, so match it to the deployment being evaluated.

quantization.quant_algo_note: Leave null for max-calibration PTQ. Set to 'svdquant' only if PTQ misses the quality bar.

scope.transformer: NVFP4 weights and activations, except the layers Model Optimizer protects
scope.attention: FP8 when --quantize-mha is set and head dimension divides by 16
scope.note: The pipeline is mixed precision, not 4-bit throughout. This is also why halving the weight precision does not halve the runtime.
